rule_text: The side face angle of the pocket should be at least 13.0 degrees for closed angle machining.
The entry and exit angles for holes should be 0.0 degrees for proper drilling.
The minimum radius for fillets on top edges should be less than or equal to 25.4 units.
The hole depth to hole diameter ratio for deep holes should be less than or equal to 8.0.
Avoid flat bottom holes
The maximum thread depth of a hole should not exceed 75% of the drill depth.
The minimum hole diameter should be at least 5.0 units.
Avoid non uniform bottom radius
Partial holes should have a wrap angle percentage of 75.0 for partial holes.
Avoid bottom chamfers for a pocket
Recommended line profile tolerance based on part size should be 0.0508 for parts with diagonal length 0.0 to 25.4.
Recommended position tolerance for holes should be 0.0254 for default.
The recommended machinability for milling operations and value should be 100.
The recommended surface finish for machined faces should be not more than 0.8.
Cored hole radius in boss should be at least 0.254 units.
Hole depth to diameter ratio should be 2.0 for blind holes and 4.0 for through holes.
Rib height should be at most 4.0 times the rib thickness.
Draft angle for text should be at least 0.5 degrees.
Draft angle for bosses should be at least 0.25 degrees for inner surfaces and 0.5 degrees for outer surfaces.
Draft angle for ribs should be at least 0.5 degrees.
Outer Diameter to Inner Diameter ratio should be at least 2.0, and Height to Outer Diameter ratio should be at least 3.0.
Recommended bottom radius for lip should be at least 0.5 times the minimum thickness.
For pins with height between 0 and 10 units recommended pin diameter should be between 0.5 and 1.5 units.
Rib height to nominal wall thickness ratio should be at least 3.0.
The recommended text height should be at least 0.2 units.
The thickness at the tip of the rib should be at least 0.8 units.
The uniform wall thickness should be between 2.0 and 3.0 units.
Distance between holes should be at least 2.0 times the sheet metal nominal thickness.
Distance between hole and bend should be at least 2.5 times the sheet metal nominal thickness.
Distance between hole and part edge should be at least 2.0 times the sheet metal nominal thickness.
Bend radius should be at least 1.3 times the sheet metal nominal thickness.
Sheet thickness should be at least 1.0 unit.
Hole diameter should be at least 1.0 times the sheet metal nominal thickness.
Clearance between tubes should be at least 5.0 units.
Overlap length between pipes should be at least 45.0 units.
Bend radius should be at least 14.2748 units for tubes with an outer diameter of 6.35 units.
Bend radius to outer diameter ratio should be at least 3.0.
All bends should have a common radius.
Ensure that blind holes have a relief value of 3.0 units, and non-blind holes have a relief value of 0.0 units
The ratio of the length to the minimum outer diameter of turned parts does not exceed 8.0.
Internal corner radius of turned parts is at least 0.5 units.
Ensure that all PMI is associated with the relevant features.
Thread sizes conform to standard sizes: 1-64 UNC, 1-72 UNF, 2-56 UNC.
External threads conform to recommended thread classes: 1A, 2A.
Internal threads conform to recommended thread classes: 1B, 2B.
The thread unit is set to English.
Wall thickness is between 5.0 units and 10.0 units.
The part body material is one of the preferred materials.
Ratio of the outer radius at base of boss to nominal thickness is at least 0.25
Ratio of the radius at base of rib to top thickness is between 0.25 and 0.5
Outer radius at tip of boss is at least 1.5 unit
Mold wall height is at least 2.0 units and ratio of mold wall thickness to nominal thickness is at least 3.0
Ratio of outer diameter to inner diameter of boss is at most 2.5
Ratio of rib height to nominal thickness is at most 3.0
Minimum wall thickness is at least 3.0 units.
Ensure minimum clearance between components is at least 0.1 units
Ensure washer is present for fasteners engaging with specific materials
Extended thread length to thread pitch ratio for a bolt is at least 2.0
Shank length is less than or equal to the clearance hole depth
Ensure there are no sharp edges in the part
The part does not exceed maximum print size: length 300, width 300, height 600
Ensure angular tolerance is at least 0.1 degrees
Text height is at least 0.6 units and text width is at least 2.0 units
Pin height is between 0 and 10 units and pin diameter is between 3 and 5 units
Wall thickness is at least 0.8 units for both supported and unsupported walls
Distance between bridges should be atleast 4.5 times sheet thickness
Card guide length should be at most 127.0 mm and opening angle should be at least 15.0 degrees.
Distance between card guide form and bend should be at least 5.0 times sheet thickness
Distance between curl and bends should be at least 4.5 times sheet thickness plus twice the rolled hem radius
Distance between curl and cutouts should be at least 3.0 times sheet thickness minus the rolled hem radius
Distance between cutout and part edge should be at least 2.0 times sheet thickness
Distance between emboss and bend should be at least 5.0 times sheet thickness
Distance between emboss and part edge should be at least 4.0 times sheet thickness
Distance between extruded form and cutouts should be at least 2.0 times sheet thickness
Distance between extruded form and part edge should be at least 4.0 times sheet thickness
Distance between hole and bend should be at least 1.5 times sheet thickness
Distance between hole and part edge should be at least 2.0 times sheet thickness
Distance between holes should be at least 2.0 times sheet thickness
Distance between louver and bend should be at least 3.0 times sheet thickness
Distance between louver and part edge should be at least 4.0 times sheet thickness
Distance between stamp and bend should be at least 2.5 times sheet thickness
Distance between stamp and part edge should be at least 4.0 times sheet thickness
Flange length should be at least 3.0 times sheet thickness
Hem length should be at least 4.0 times sheet thickness
Minimum bridge width should be at least 3.0 times sheet thickness
For material 6061-T6 flange radius should be atleast 1.0 mm and length 6.0 mm.
Minimum width for spoon should be 0.8 times sheet thickness
Minimum clearance between cutout and part edge should be 2.0 mm
Slot width should be at least 1.0 times sheet thickness
